'''Poi''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can be purchased from [[Leo]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] during the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|20|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

==Bundles==
Poi is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Poi is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Poi is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Hot Pink Shirt]].  [[File:Hot Pink Shirt.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
